plotEn:
Elliot, the 23-year-old assistant and lover of renowned contemporary artist Erika Tracy, discovers her floating unconscious in the swimming pool at her home. 
Nine and a half weeks earlier, Elliot is unemployed and living with his best friend, Apple, when Erika hires him as a studio assistant. Dissatisfied with his relationship with his girlfriend, Minerva, he becomes attracted to Erika. The two begin a sexual relationship in which Erika assumes a dominant role. Despite warnings from her business manager, Vikktor, Elliot grows increasingly attached to her and breaks up with Minerva.
As Erika prepares for a major exhibition, she asks Elliot to bring another partner to her home, and he invites Apple. The encounter deteriorates when Erika disregards Elliot’s boundaries, causing a confrontation that also damages his friendship with Apple. Apple subsequently asks him to move out, and he stays with his fellow studio assistant, Zap.
At the exhibition’s opening, Elliot discovers that Erika has incorporated recordings of their sexual encounters into her work. When he confronts her, she pretends not to know him and has him removed from the gallery. The exhibition initially fails, and publicity surrounding their confrontation further damages Erika’s reputation.
